product_one_liner.value: Cast AI provides Kubernetes automation and optimization for DevOps and platform teams to manage workloads, reduce cloud costs, and improve performance.
product_one_liner.notes: Cast AI documentation describes the product as a Kubernetes automation, optimization, security, and cost-management platform; the press release specifies DevOps and platform teams and workload management, cost reduction, and performance improvement.

pricing_page.notes: Cast AI has a public pricing page that offers a pricing request and custom quote, which qualifies as a public pricing page even without listed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Cast AI press release explicitly says the company is trusted by BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, and Swisscom. | named_customers.0: The press release names BMW as a customer. | named_customers.1: The press release names Cisco as a customer. | named_customers.2: The press release names FICO as a customer. | named_customers.3: The press release names HuggingFace as a customer. | named_customers.4: The press release names Swisscom as a customer.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The profile places Cast AI in Miami, United States. | hq_country: The profile explicitly identifies Miami as being in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Tracxn company profile states Cast AI was founded in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering archive is a technical blog index and includes multiple technical posts, including one on Karpenter node consolidation and another on LLM inference cost optimization, meeting the two-post threshold. The excerpts do not independently establish author roles, so confidence is medium.

public_docs.notes: Cast AI provides a public documentation site with Guides, API Reference, and Release Notes, and the docs landing page describes user guides and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Cast AI’s live career listing is for a Senior Applied ML Engineer, and the accompanying description concerns ownership of the model/router.

model_provider.value: Its AI Enabler documentation lists support for OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, and self-hosted vLLM (hosted_vllm).
model_provider.notes: Cast AI documentation names OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, and Mistral as external API providers and gives examples including OpenAI and self-hosted hosted_vllm. The answer describes providers the product says it supports, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Cast AI trust-center badge listing names ISO27001 Audit Certificate, PCI DSS AOC, and SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.0: The trust-center badge names SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The trust-center badge names an ISO27001 audit certificate. | compliance_certs.2: The trust-center badge names PCI DSS AOC.
